QuestInfo.name: Urban Jungle
QuestInfo.0: There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal?
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Jack Masque. He's a bandit prince from Amoria. He's in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He's got a passionate hatred for #o9400545#s, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I've agreed to hunt down 100 #o9400545#s in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the MesoGears...
QuestInfo.2: *Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky #o9400545#s, and in return, I received 5 #t2022194#s from Jack Masque. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...?

0.0: Hello there. Do you have a moment to spare?

yes.0: Wonderful. Name's Jack. Jack Masque. I'm from Amoria, but that's neither here nor there...it's a long story why I left...but since you're still here, I'll give you the short version. I'm in love! I am lost in the throes of passion with the most beautiful creature I have laid eyes upon...a Princess. Princess Restless to be exact. I'm competing for her with some snob-nosed prince. We were out on our first date, and the time was perfect. The sun was shining, birds were tweeting, and just as I was about to receive a kiss from her sweet lips, this strange spider attacked us! I fought the beast off, but that was a one in a million chance with her! I swore to wear this mask in shame until I could return to Amoria with honor. But I must hurry, that accursed Prince Vince is sure to attempt to steal her away...So, I want you to go and eliminate 100 #o9400545#s, which should ensure that this never happens again. If you're successful, I have a particularly rare crystal that may suit you...get going!

no.0: Unfortunate. Be on your way then!

1.0: Fantastic! I'll be able to face her again without worrying if one of those pesky #o9400545#s will spoil the moment. As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy! And tomorrow, you may return to me for another hunt in case more spiders appear! \n\n#L0##bActually, can you tell me more about yourself?#k#l
1.1: Anything else you wish to know? \n\n#L0##bWhy is that mask really on your face?#k#l
1.2: I'm a prideful man, and the thought that I lost my chance due to a spider is... rather embarrassing to be honest. Icebyrd offered me a chance to redeem myself, and I took it. I won't take off this mask until I can return to Amoria with honor! You've helped me and I never forget a favor. I may have a few tasks for you in the future. With your help, I'm sure that I'd get a leg up on that walking waste of space known as Prince Vince... Does this answer your question?

yes.0: As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy! Return to me tomorrow for another hunt!

mob.0: Tsk, tsk. So sad. I said #b100 #o9400545#s#k. Not 74, not 32, not 99. 100. Come back when you have something to show for your effort - besides a tired face.
